description: Returns the curated JSON-LD structured data graphs (Service, SoftwareApplication, Product, Offer, Review, FAQ, Breadcrumb…) for a Siigo landing page, plus SEO metadata. Use this when the user asks about a specific Siigo product or topic and you want canonical, schema.org-ready data. Example call: {"country": "COL", "slug": "facturacion-electronica"}. Pages with no JSON-LD still return title + seo with an empty jsonLdGraphs array.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Only countries listed in DependencyInjection:ProfileInjector:Actives are served. Examples: COL, MEX, ECU.

slug.description: WordPress page slug, without leading slash. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, max 200 chars. Real COL slugs: facturacion-electronica, nomina-electronica, software-contable, gestion-de-inventario, sistema-de-costos, gestion-de-cobranza, precios-siigo, por-que-siigo, prueba-gratis. An unknown slug returns 'Page not found'.

name: get_page_structured_data
